title: Pixel
tagline: A tool allows you to create cool pixelated art over mint as NFT on Cronos blockchain
description:
With this tool, you can create all sorts of amazing pixelated designs, and then mint them as NFTs. 

This means that you can create unique, one-of-a-kind artworks that can be stored securely on the blockchain. Plus, as an added bonus, you can also use this tool to create NFTs for other purposes, such as digital collectibles, gaming assets, and more. 

So if you're looking for a cool way to create and store your art, it's a great way to get started with NFTs, and it's a lot of fun too!  Using blockchains like Cronos and IPFS for storing data makes it really fast, cheap, and decentralized so you don't have to worry about losing your data.
how_its_made:
I use Cronos for blockchain and IPFS for storing all the art that's user generated. and for the frontend, I use Html canvas and Js for all logical parts.
